name: wuniq-mcp
description: Connect Codex to the local-first Wuniq Knowledge Engine for persistent, structured project context.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Wuniq's local-first Knowledge Engine. Read and maintain decisions, constraints, intent, and reasoning stored beside project files. Requires the free Wuniq desktop app for Windows or Linux.
defaultPrompt: Open the Wuniq projects visible to you and summarize the context relevant to this task.
Read this module's Wuniq context before changing it and preserve the confirmed decisions.
Record this decision and its rationale in Wuniq, then synchronize after the change.
